title: What I solve
line: From straightforward ROI questions to vague & complex problems, I've faced them across domains.

areas.name: Brand
problems: People know you, like you, and still don't choose you
Positioning that doesn't match how people actually live
Moving into a new city tier, region or audience

areas.name: Comms
areas.short: Say the thing that actually moves people.
problems: Messages people hear but don't act on
Campaigns built on the wrong insight
Speaking to many Indias without losing the one voice

areas.name: Sales
problems: Interest that doesn't turn into a purchase
Customers who try once and don't come back
Offers, prices or payment options read differently than you meant
areas.short: Turn interest into purchase, and purchase into repeat.

areas.name: Product
problems: New product development: what to build, for whom, and why it will be picked up
Features people ask for but don't use
Habits that don't stick: onboarding, adoption, retention
Building for the many Indias, not one 'Indian user'

areas.name: Foresight
problems: Shifting cultural trends and what they mean for your category
Future outlooks for markets, categories and behaviour
Interventions that look right on paper and fail on the ground
areas.short: See the shift before it shows up in the numbers.

lead: The problem you bring me is usually one version of the real one. I find the real one in the field, by understanding the context people actually live in, and then design what changes their behaviour.
scales: From zero-to-one launches to national brands and globally funded public health programmes, with teams from field sales up to the board.
roi: Fewer failed launches: test ideas against real lives before the money is spent
Higher conversion and repeat: fix the real barrier, not the assumed one
Spend where it works: clear calls on where to grow and where to cut
Better decisions: insight that ends in a roadmap, a launch plan or a sales plan, not a deck
how: Deep context interviews, field immersion, longitudinal studies and behavioural design. Research that ends in decisions, not decks.

ca.text: Context Architecture™ is the science of mapping the elements that stimulate reactions out of us. It is the marriage of many disciplines, distilled into one lens.
